key_insight: The paper combines symmetry constraints with AI-guided search to make high-distance magic-state factory discovery tractable, yielding many new distillation protocols with lower overhead for fault-tolerant quantum computing.
engineering_relevance: This advances practical quantum error correction by reducing the resource cost of magic-state distillation, a dominant bottleneck in scalable fault-tolerant architectures.
method: Unified binary-matrix formulation for triorthogonal-code and direct circuit searches
Restrict syndrome selection using group symmetry plus language-model agents
Deterministic solving and independent verification of candidate factories
evidence_signal: The authors report 699 factory classes, including 564 new ones, and highlight low-overhead pure-T factories such as [[63, 11, 3]], [[850, 128, 6]], and [[1715, 287, 6]].
watch_item: The approach still depends on search heuristics and post-filtering, so results may be sensitive to symmetry choices, agent prompts, and solver scalability at even larger input counts.
paper_title: Symmetry and AI-assisted discovery of magic-state factories
